items.origin: Jewish tradition, as reported in some tafsir books
items.claim: A tale in which Satan takes Sulayman’s ring and rules in his place for forty days.
items.ruling: Not told here. Ma’ariful Qur’an reports it as drawn only from Jewish narrations, rejects it as the meaning of 38:34, and quotes Ibn Kathir that the People of the Book, who deny Sulayman’s prophethood, forged such tales. It also finds no source for its details.
items.basis: Ma’ariful Qur’an (English edition, read on Quran.com), on 38:34; Qur’an 2:102 (Sulayman did not disbelieve)
